name: LEDrum
author: amnmkkr
description: A drum voice for kicks, toms, snares, hats and zaps: an oscillator with FM or additive mixing, a pitch envelope, a multimode filter, an amp envelope with adjustable curve, transient samples and distortion. A modified port of the drum voice in the open-source Erica Synths LXR-02 firmware; not affiliated with Erica Synths.
